decisions.statement: The reading is taken where Alan's cookie is rather than where the site runs.
Only the count the tile shows is kept.
The moment kept is the moment the reading was asked for.
A taking that refuses keeps nothing.
A run of this file takes a reading.
The cookie is read from the environment by name.
A cookie that is not set refuses by that name and says only Alan can produce a cookie.
A refusal is said as one line rather than thrown as a stack.
A cookie that is not set and a taking that refuses leave on different codes.
The root read is the root the environment states or the folder the call was made in.
An empty value in the environment states no root.
Where the readout's page sits is asked of the index rather than spelled.
Importing this file takes no reading.
Nothing here decides when a reading is due.

definition: the unreviewed count taken from Monarch and kept on its readout
